groups.sentence: Instructors align their course AI policies with department or program policies, guidance and disciplinary standards before the course begins.
Instructors discuss AI use and expectations with department colleagues, chairs and peers, and work toward shared approaches.
Departments and academic units discuss, encourage and facilitate consistent AI approaches and statements among faculty.
Instructors discuss and agree with department colleagues on appropriate penalties for unauthorized AI use.
Instructors coordinate AI expectations across course sequences, shared curricula and graduate committees so students meet consistent expectations.
Instructors develop shared syllabus language specific to the discipline or course.
Faculty and administrators hold ongoing department conversations about appropriate penalties for unauthorized AI use.
Programs may encourage teaching assistants to connect with supervising faculty so student AI use complies with class guidelines.
Faculty follow the agreed syllabus learning outcomes.
Administrators ensure students receive consistent, clear information about permissible AI use across syllabi, assignments and university communications.
Appropriate AI use differs across disciplines, courses, programs and contexts.
Students are confused by differing AI rules across courses, and consistent language clarifies expectations.
This guidance supplements or sits alongside other institutional AI policies and guidelines.
